message: `StateAction`, `AuthenticateTarget`, and `AuthenticateTargetKind` gain model source variants, so exhaustive matches and switches must handle them. `AuthenticateTarget` is now a union, so TypeScript code that reads `target.session` or `target.customizationId` must first narrow on `target.kind`. Direct Rust struct literals for `RootState` must now include `model_sources: None`, those for `AgentCapabilities` must include `model_source_registration: None`, and those for `ErrorInfo` must include `error_code: None`.
